data.conventions_summary: This is the Pallets Click repository, a Python project organized in a src-based layout with its package code under src/, tests under tests/, documentation under docs/, and additional usage samples under examples/. It uses uv for dependency management and environment setup, so you should use uv rather than pip when installing requirements locally. The test suite is run with pytest, and code style is enforced by ruff, which acts as both the formatter and the linter; run ruff checks on your changes before committing. Continuous integration is handled via GitHub Actions, though the specific workflow details were not examined beyond the presence of workflow files. Any other contributor requirements, such as commit-message conventions or additional build steps, were not detected.
